title: AS2: global startDrag(target) with 1 arg (and 3-5 args) crashes the compiler
description: FIXED. packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts startDrag built-in now branches on arg count without out-of-bounds reads: n>=3 constrain form (pads missing coords 0), n>=1 target[,lockCenter] no-constrain, n==0 self. Regression 'startDrag(_root.mc);' no longer throws. Added tests: packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/globalstartdrag.test.ts (7 arities 0-6, all assert ActionStartDrag 0x27). Build: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0. Tests: 7/7 new pass; full @flash/core suite 5673 pass (1 unrelated flaky wall-clock perf test in largetimeline.test.ts, passes in isolation).
